title: PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG
abstract: arXiv:2609.36087v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. translated_title: PHASE：一种生理学引导的层级化颅内脑电基础模型
translated_abstract: 临床医生和神经科学家长期以来一直通过可直接测量的生理特征来分析颅内脑电（iEEG），这些特征承载了下游任务所依赖的大部分信息。近期的iEEG基础模型通过重构或预测其输入来进行学习，这使得这些特征的保留成为隐式的。此外，这些模型主要在认知解码和狭窄的临床任务（即癫痫发作检测）上进行评估。在如Omni-iEEG这样广泛且具有临床相关性的基准测试中，冻结使用时它们的表现仍低于任务特定模型。我们提出了PHASE，一种生理学引导的基础模型，它将这些生理特征作为显式的学习目标，并将其与掩码潜在预测相结合：在每个通道内的时间阶段（PHASE-T）以及跨同步通道的时空阶段（PHASE-ST）。PHASE在来自九个临床中心的222名参与者的异构记录数据上进行预训练。
tldr: PHASE是一种生理学引导的颅内脑电基础模型，它将可直接测量的生理特征作为显式学习目标，通过通道内时间阶段（PHASE-T）与跨通道时空阶段（PHASE-ST）的两级层级化预训练并结合掩码潜在预测，在广泛的临床基准上冻结使用时超越了现有基础模型。
en_tdlr: PHASE is a physiology-guided hierarchical foundation model for intracranial EEG that explicitly targets directly measurable physiological characteristics, combining them with masked latent prediction across a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within channels and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels, outperforming existing foundation models on broad clinical benchmarks when used frozen.
